 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Extend same-color diagonal runs through the background to the grid edge/obstacle."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0]) if out else 0
    if not h or not w:
        return out
    # The uniform field is the background; matching diagonal neighbors define rays.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in out for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seeds = [(r, c, dr, dc, out[r][c])
             for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if out[r][c] != bg
             for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1))
             if 0 <= r + dr < h and 0 <= c + dc < w
             and out[r + dr][c + dc] == out[r][c]]
    for r, c, dr, dc, color in seeds:
        # Extend both ends of each observed diagonal pair; retain all non-background cells.
        for sr, sc, ar, ac in ((r, c, -dr, -dc), (r + dr, c + dc, dr, dc)):
            rr, cc = sr + ar, sc + ac
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                if out[rr][cc] != bg:
                    break
                out[rr][cc] = color
                rr += ar
                cc += ac
    return out
"
